issues.desc: index.json riskSignals contains category:Data Migration/Destructive (matched:migration) and category:Production/Emergency (matched:production) auto-elevated from keyword scan. The background explicitly confirms these are known false-positives for a test-maintenance story with no data migration and no production code change. The main agent should call story_review_dismiss to remove these signals and restore priority to medium so REVIEW stage does not trigger unwarranted high-risk gates. No action required to unblock INIT_CHECK — flagged as advisory only.
